item.title: The Religious Experience of Philip K. Dick by R. Crumb (1986)
Japan tried to build an operating system for the world, the US intervened
item.description:
📝 That project was TRON (The Real-time Operating system Nucleus), a real, government-backed Japanese computing initiative whose desktop variant, BTRON, was named in a US trade barrier report and effectively killed before it could reach schools nationwide. To put that in perspective, Unicode 1. A large part of that count came from Mojikyo, though, which separately encodes variant glyphs that Unicode unifies into single code points.
🔗 Read more: https://www.xda-developers.com/japan-tried-build-operating-system-entire-world-us-government-intervened/
